extracted.name: Thai green curry paste
extracted.description: Use this Thai green curry paste to make an authentic Thai green curry. You can adapt it by adding more lemongrass, chilli or lime leaves
ingredient_lines: 1 lemongrass stalk tough outer leaves discarded, finely chopped
4-6 green chillies deseeded if you prefer less heat, chopped
thumb-sized piece of galangal peeled and chopped
½ small bunch of coriander finely chopped
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a small food processor and blend until smooth. Add another tablespoon of oil, if needed, to combine. Freeze any leftover paste for another time, or make a double or triple batch to freeze in portions.
